name: organize
title: Organize
description: Organize your Downloads, Desktop, and Temp folders by removing duplicates, archiving old files, and sorting by file type.
author: kishan_vagale

commands.name: organize-downloads
commands.title: Organize Downloads
commands.subtitle: Organize
commands.description: Organize your Downloads folder by removing duplicates, archiving old files, and sorting by file type. Includes undo option.

commands.name: organize-desktop
commands.title: Organize Desktop
commands.subtitle: Organize
commands.description: Organize your Desktop by removing duplicates, archiving old files, and sorting by file type. Includes undo option.

commands.name: organize-temp
commands.title: Organize Temp Folder
commands.subtitle: Organize
commands.description: Organize your Documents/Temp folder by removing duplicates and organizing files by type. Includes undo option.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
